newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Tuesday, with sentiment remaining weak on lingering worries of a possible government intervention, dealers said.
They said ready palm olein in Jakarta has remained stable between 1,490-1,500 rupiah/kg and at 1,450-1,460 rupiah/kg in Medan since Monday.
"Players are worried the government may intervene in the market in the coming days to push prices down," one trader said.
The dealer noted that the closure of the Chicago soyoil futures market for a holiday on Monday also restricted activity.
Indonesia's state logistics agency BULOG said recently it planned to intervene in the market to push palm olein prices down in an effort to stabilise cooking oil prices.
Dealers said there were no crude palm oil deals heard.
Crude palm oil was last traded at 1,240 rupiah after a tender late last week, they said.
